style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, warm analog film grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling. No text, no captions, no inscriptions, no readable letters, no film stock branding, no Kodak or Portra labels, no frame numbers, no aspect ratio markers, no watermarks. No modern objects, no asphalt, no painted road markings, no vehicles, no cars, no motorcycles, no machinery. No human figures, no faces, no body parts, no hands. 1st-century Mediterranean Levantine setting only.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: Fear God, Not People
images.concept: Nothing hidden that will not be exposed — authentic faith under the pressure of a watching crowd
images.imageAlt: Morning fog dissolving to reveal a stone wall, the wall fully visible in one patch of clearing and hidden in mist elsewhere
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, morning fog slowly dissolving to reveal an ancient stone wall, one section of the wall fully illuminated and visible in a clearing patch of pale morning light while the rest of the wall disappears into dense white mist on both sides, the revealed stone section showing every texture and imperfection with absolute clarity, heavy warm analog film grain in the fog, muted palette of warm stone and cool fog white, the partial revealing — what the light uncovers cannot be re-hidden, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: The Rich Fool
images.concept: Bigger barns full tonight, soul required tonight — the grotesque gap between accumulation and life
images.imageAlt: A large clay storage jar cracked open on a stone floor, grain spilling out and scattering, the crack running from top to base
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a large ancient clay storage jar sitting on a stone floor with a long crack running from its rim to its base, grain slowly spilling from the crack and forming a small pile on the stone floor below, the jar's surface showing careful construction now undone, raking side light from the left emphasizing the crack and the spilled grain, heavy film grain throughout, muted warm palette of pale clay and golden grain and pale stone floor, the cracked vessel losing what it held — accumulation interrupted, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9

images.title: Ravens and Lilies
images.concept: Clothed more beautifully than Solomon — the field teaches what anxiety cannot learn
images.imageAlt: Wild grass and a single small wildflower in late afternoon golden light, a feather resting nearby on the ground
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, close macro view of wild grass and a single small pale wildflower in late afternoon golden light, the flower's petals slightly translucent in the backlight, a single dark feather resting on the ground nearby, the whole scene overlit to the edge of overexposure with warmth, heavy warm analog film grain in the shadowed grass, muted warm palette of pale gold and faded green, the flower and feather as the argument against anxiety — both provided for without striving, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: Watchful Servants
images.concept: Lamps lit, belts fastened — the readiness that cannot know the hour but must be ready for it
images.imageAlt: Several lit oil lamps in a dark interior arranged in a row on a stone ledge, the darkness beyond them absolute
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a row of small clay oil lamps placed on a stone ledge in a dark interior, each lamp burning with a small warm flame, the row of light creating a pattern of amber circles that diminish into the darkness beyond the frame, the interior darkness absolute beyond the lamps, heavy warm analog film grain in the darkness, muted palette with only the amber lamp flames as warmth, the row of burning lamps against absolute darkness — readiness as visible posture, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9

images.title: Not Peace but Division
images.concept: Fire cast on the earth — discipleship that splits households along the fault line of allegiance
images.imageAlt: A stone surface with a single deep fissure running the full length of the frame, one side slightly higher than the other, harsh noon light
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a stone surface viewed from above with a single decisive fissure or crack running the full length of the frame from left edge to right edge, the two halves of the stone separated at the crack with one side raised slightly higher than the other as if under geological stress, harsh flat noon light with no softening shadows, the crack sharp and decisive, heavy film grain in the stone texture, muted pale stone palette, the split stone — not a wound but a structural revelation, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: Signs of the Times
images.concept: You read the sky but not the moment — the present crisis more legible than any weather pattern
images.imageAlt: Storm clouds building on a horizon over flat land, a small patch of blue sky still visible, the light changing quality
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a flat landscape under a sky that is rapidly changing, heavy dark clouds building from the left and upper portions of the frame while a small remaining patch of pale blue sky holds at the right edge, the quality of light across the flat land below altered and ominous, heavy warm analog film grain in the cloud mass, muted near-monochrome palette of dark cloud gray and pale remaining sky, the weather that anyone can read — and the moment it points beyond itself, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9
